title: Re:Zero: From Zero
alt: On a wide stone terrace high over a city, a girl with short blue hair in a black and white maid dress holds the hand of a boy in a black jacket with an orange collar. She looks up at him. Behind them are red and blue roofs, a white castle with blue spires, and tall white clouds in a bright blue sky. White doves fly up to the right.
summary: A painting of the scene From Zero from Re:Zero in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is the end of episode 18 of Re:Zero − Starting Life in Another World, from the novels by Tappei Nagatsuki. Subaru has failed too many times, and he asks Rem to run away with him. She will not. She tells him what she sees in him, and that she loves him.
He stands up again. He says that he will start from zero, and she smiles. They are on a terrace over the capital of Lugunica, and doves go up past them. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
